content.value_statement: Video motion can fail when timelines are not deterministic or seek-safe. This skill guides HyperFrames keyframe authoring and verification with practical runtime patterns.
actual_capabilities: Selects suitable keyframe mechanisms for GSAP, CSS, Anime.js, WAAPI, SVG, and WebGL motion.
Explains how to register paused timelines and animation instances for frame-accurate HyperFrames rendering.
Guides visible pose planning for subject identity, final state, timing, and readable text motion.
Provides diagnostic workflows using HyperFrames lint, validate, keyframes, shot, ghost, and snapshot checks.
Covers 2D transforms, FLIP movement, path travel, masks, stroke draw, shape morphing, and 3D depth proof.
limitations: It does not plan complete video narratives, scripts, captions, or brand strategy.
It does not source media assets or design a full visual system.
It assumes the user is working inside a HyperFrames composition project.
It provides guidance and examples, not a standalone rendering engine.

use_cases.title: Build deterministic product motion
use_cases.description: Create product UI movement that keeps identity, visible states, and final lockups stable during rendering.

use_cases.title: Validate animation proof frames
use_cases.description: Use focused diagnostics to confirm key poses, paths, text readability, and final frames before export.

use_cases.title: Repair unseekable composition timing
use_cases.description: Replace timers, autoplay, random values, and late timeline creation with deterministic runtime patterns.

prompt_templates.title: Plan simple motion
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a basic seek-safe animation plan.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use hyperframes-keyframes to plan a seek-safe keyframe approach for this HyperFrames scene: [describe scene and motion goal].

prompt_templates.title: Choose a runtime
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for selecting the best animation mechanism.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use hyperframes-keyframes to choose between GSAP, CSS keyframes, Anime.js, and WAAPI for this motion: [motion details]. Explain the verification steps.

prompt_templates.title: Fix render timing
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for repairing nondeterministic animation behavior.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use hyperframes-keyframes to audit this HyperFrames animation for seek safety: [paste relevant composition details]. Identify risky channels and replacement patterns.

prompt_templates.title: Prove complex depth
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for 3D, WebGL, or camera motion validation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use hyperframes-keyframes to design keyframes and diagnostics for this 3D or WebGL motion: [describe scene, camera, objects, and proof frames].

output_examples.input: A card should move from a list into a larger detail panel without looking like a crossfade.
output: Use one continuous subject or a FLIP-style shared element transition.
Keyframe transform and scale, then hold the final detail state long enough to read.
Verify with a focused shot across start, middle, final-minus-hold, and final frames.

output_examples.input: A logo outline should draw on and settle into a complete mark.
output: Use stroke draw through DrawSVG or SVG dash values.
Capture partial, nearly complete, and final frames to confirm the outline is visible.
Avoid ending on a reset or black frame unless the prompt requests it.

output_examples.input: A WebGL object should fly through depth while the camera tracks it.
output: Drive camera, target, object transform, and material values from deterministic timeline progress.
Use ghost or snapshot diagnostics because DOM boxes cannot prove internal canvas motion.
Check an angled proof view when depth crossing is important.

best_practices: Name the moving subject, proof poses, final state, and runtime before writing animation code.
Build timelines synchronously, pause them, and register them for HyperFrames frame seeking.
Verify the smallest failing diagnostic before rendering the full video.
anti_patterns: Do not use timers, unseeded random values, autoplay, or late timeline creation for render-critical motion.
Do not animate layout channels when transforms, opacity, masks, or shader uniforms can prove the motion.
Do not rely on endpoint-only motion when the viewer needs middle poses to understand the action.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps create deterministic keyframe motion for HyperFrames compositions that can be rendered frame by frame.

faq.question: Which animation runtimes does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers GSAP, CSS keyframes, Anime.js, WAAPI, SVG animation patterns, Three.js, and WebGL keyframe state.

faq.question: Does it replace HyperFrames documentation?
faq.answer: No. It gives focused keyframe authoring guidance and points users toward validation commands and runtime patterns.

faq.question: Can it design an entire video?
faq.answer: No. Use a broader HyperFrames video workflow for script, scene structure, brand direction, and media planning.

faq.question: Why does it emphasize seek safety?
faq.answer: HyperFrames rendering captures exact frames, so animation state must be reproducible at any requested timestamp.

faq.question: When should I use CLI diagnostics?
faq.answer: Use them after authoring motion to confirm targets, poses, paths, readable text, depth, and final frames.
